content:
Greta: Uploaded a new prototype: credentials table with a right-hand details flyout (created/last-used + rotate history) instead of showing timestamps in the main table. Figma: https://figma.com/file/flyout-proto
Samir: I like the flyout for audits, but note two things: keep row hit targets >=44px for touch and keyboard, and avoid layout shift when flyout opens. Use slide-over that overlays content.
June: Revoke flow: current mock shows inline trash icon. That causes accidental clicks. Move revoke into the kebab menu and require a confirm modal. If we show an "undo" in the toast, gate copy behind the feature flag.
Rafi: Backend check: do we have undo? @a11y-bot can you confirm staging flag and endpoint status?
a11y-bot: Feature flag `key_revoke_undo` = off in staging. Endpoint POST /keys/{id}/undo exists but is experimental and rate-limited.
Samir: Ok, so copy must be conditional. If flag off, modal copy should read: "Revoke API key — this will immediately stop calls and cannot be undone." If flag on: "Revoke API key — this will immediately stop calls. Undo available for 30s." Also make undo button keyboard-focusable and announced via aria-live.
June: Empty state needs clearer guidance with the flyout pattern. Proposal: Title: "Create an API key", Body: "Start calling Redwood Inference. Use scoped permissions to limit access." Primary CTA: "Create API key" Secondary link: "Scopes & best practices" (link opens docs). Center the CTA and include a small info line about rotation best practices.
Greta: For permission chips, add a left color bar for quick scanning but keep full-text label and aria-label (e.g., "permission: write"). Also ensure contrast >=4.5:1 and visible focus outlines for keyboard nav.
Rafi: QA checklist to include in PR: 1) keyboard tab order and focus trap for flyout/modal, 2) 44px min touch targets, 3) ARIA labels for chips and action buttons, 4) aria-live announcements for revoke success/error and undo toast, 5) color contrast verification and 200% text scaling test.
Samir: One microcopy tweak: replace generic "Rotate" with "Rotate (issue new key and revoke old)" to avoid confusion that rotate edits the same token.
Greta: Action list: 1) move revoke to kebab + confirm modal, 2) add details flyout for timestamps, 3) conditional revoke/undo copy based on `key_revoke_undo`, 4) update empty state copy and CTA placement, 5) add QA/a11y checklist to PR template. Will update figma and ping for a quick pass.
June: Thanks — please include a short note in the PR description about the feature-flagged copy so reviewers can confirm behavior in staging vs prod.
Greta: Will do. Ping me for a review after the figma update.
